name: rembg
description_en: Rembg is a tool to remove images background
readme_excerpt: Rembg is a tool to remove image backgrounds. It can be used as a CLI, Python library, HTTP server, or Docker container. Sponsors PhotoRoom Remove Background API https://photoroom.com/api Fast and accurate background remover API If this project has helped you, please consider making a donation.
